name: KS Elementor Shortcode Slider
author: coolkul

sections.description:
KS Elementor Shortcode Slider is a flexible and lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to create a custom slider within Elementor using shortcodes or posts. You can select post categories, customize the transition speed, and enable navigation arrows or numbered pagination dots.

🎯 Key Features:
– Slide Elementor shortcodes or any other shortcodes
– Display WordPress posts as slides with category selection
– Enable/disable navigation arrows
– Numbered pagination dots for better user experience
– Adjustable transition speed for smooth animations
– Lightweight & optimized for performance

🚀 Perfect for testimonials, product showcases, custom Elementor sections, and more!

Video

See the plugin in action! Watch our complete setup tutorial and demo:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cYcsBnF7–g
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin and upload it to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any Elementor page and add the Shortcode Slider widget.
  4. Configure the settings and enjoy your custom slider!
sections.faq:
Q: Can I use this plugin without Elementor?

A: Yes! You can insert the shortcode directly into posts, pages, or widgets.

Q: Does this plugin support custom post types?

A: Currently, it supports standard posts and Elementor shortcodes. Future updates may add custom post type support.

Q: Is this plugin responsive?

A: Yes, KS Elementor Shortcode Slider is fully responsive and mobile-friendly.
